message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. The first blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, preventing admin_dc and admin_adfs. The second then blocks authentication to DB, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if database administrator credentials are stolen. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server credential-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration. Any other single control leaves the phishing-to-internal-access-to-DC route open: segmentation alone is bypassed by escalating a phished workstation, and any individual patch leaves alternative paths available."}
